notes: Player-led Arcade update. Solitaire: larger red circus table, full illustrated deck, centered foundations, lower draw tray showing three cards with only the top playable, manual card moves, stock shuffling, Undo and New Deal. Pinball: larger machine, draggable spring with real launch strength, two extra bumpers and effects-only audio. Pool: easier cue pickup, fine aiming, sound effects, New Round and correct ball-in-hand after fouls. Snakes and Ladders: roll-strength control, animated fair dice and manual legal token placement. Relaxed Checkers: optional captures, backward captures, flying kings, optional capture continuation, brighter orange pieces, effects-only audio and New Game. Every game menu offers renewal and Exit to Main Menu; guests can request a renewal and the host approves. Update every phone and start a new match for the new rules. Existing room codes, saved games and matches are retained; older matches keep their old rules.
